subtests.name: A module stylesheet link with type=null uses import.
A module stylesheet link with type="" uses import.
A module stylesheet link with type="text/css" uses import.
A module stylesheet link with type="text/plain" uses import.
Removing import before insertion selects classic fetching.
Restoring import before insertion selects module fetching.
Changing to preload before insertion selects the appropriate fetching mode.
Restoring stylesheet before insertion selects the appropriate fetching mode.
A nonempty import attribute takes precedence over a valid href.
